simple.meaning: מַסֶּכֶת (maççeketh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something expanded , i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַסֶּכֶת (H4545) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 16:13, with occurrences in Judges.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַסֶּכֶת (H4545) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַסֶּכֶת (H4545) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַסֶּכֶת (maççeketh) / H4545 is traced through Judges 16:13, Judges 16:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: something expanded , i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof)
definitions.full: H4545. masseketh [ מַסֶּ֫כֶת ] noun feminine web of unfinished stuff, on loom (see GFM PAOS, Oct. 1889, clxxvii ); — only absolute מַסָּ֑כֶת Judg 16:13-14 ,. — מְסֻכָה מָסָךְ, see סכך .
definitions.rootNote: from 5259 in the sense of spreading out;

occurrences.englishText: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.”
She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.
